TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place for the Live Music Concert “Heritage India Tour: Dr. Satinder Sartaj Live” at Jawahar Lal Nehru Stadium, Lodhi Colony on 14.02.2026 (Saturday). 

Due to an expected gathering of approx. 35,000 spectators, restrictions/diversions will apply for smooth traffic flow and public safety.

Time: 04:00 PM – 10:00 PM

📍 STADIUM ENTRY GATES
-General Entry: Gate No. 8, 13, 14 & 21
-VIP Entry: Gate No. 5
-Artist/Organisers: Gate No. 10
-Gate No. 1 & 10 reserved for emergency/contingency use

📍 PARKING ARRANGEMENTS
-VIP/Organisers: Inside JLN Stadium (Gate No. 1, West Block Open Space)
-General Public: Sewa Nagar Bus Depot, Sunheri Pulla Bus Depot, CGO Complex & SCOPE Complex Parking

📍 LIKELY TRAFFIC DIVERSIONS / RESTRICTIONS
-Diversions around JLN Red Light, Sewa Nagar Red Light, 5th Avenue Road, Pragati Vihar Red Light & Lala Lajpat Rai Marg T-Point
-Restrictions on JLN Service Road & Barapullah stretch near stadium gates
-Heavy vehicles restricted on B.P. Marg & Lodhi Road stretch during event hours

📍 PUBLIC ADVISORY
-Avoid B.P. Marg, Lodhi Road & roads around JLN Stadium during event hours
-Prefer Metro — JLN Stadium (Violet Line) is the nearest station
-Emergency vehicles will have free passage

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
